notes: Structure works: texture hook, name, blend proof, finish proof, hold on the label. Each beat has one job.
Pacing is even. Short lines fit every slot, and nothing is crammed into the 2s opener or the 3s close.
Shots 2-4 repeat on-screen text word for word in the VO. That wastes spoken seconds and sounds like a label read aloud.
Shots 3 and 4 have room for a second distinct benefit in the VO, so the viewer hears something new beyond what they read.
Shot 2's VO is the product name, which the name card already shows. A cooling cue fits the slow gel spread better.
Shot 5 shows SPF 50+ PA++++ on the label, but the line is generic. It is an end shot, so I left it untouched. 'Explore the formula.' is a weak CTA.
Edits keep the on-screen text and change only the VO, so each VO is a verbatim fact. Timing is unchanged.

The split-frame shows the gel blending in, so the VO describes the action while the on-screen text proves the result. The two no longer repeat each other.
